deploybot: Build pipeline started for release tag release/v1.9.3 on staging — commit 4f3a7c9. Steps: lint -> unit -> integration -> deploy. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/4f3a7c9

maria: copying, will watch the lint step.

deploybot: [lint] FAILED (00:32) — errors in packages/sdk/src/index.ts

``` 
packages/sdk/src/index.ts:12:5 - error TS2717: Subsequent property declarations must have the same type.
12     anyValue: any;
       ~~~~~~~~
packages/sdk/src/utils.ts:8:10 - error ESLint: 'no-explicit-any' error (eslint-config-redwood v2.5.0)
```

kevin: looks like eslint-config-redwood was bumped to v2.5.0 and it's now blocking with `no-explicit-any` as error. We can either quick-fix types in SDK (touching exported types) or pin the eslint-config to v2.4.0 for this release.

olivia: quick patch might be risky for public types. pinning the config sounds safer for a hotfix.

kevin: agreed — I'll open a hotfix PR that pins eslint-config-redwood@2.4.0 in package.json and lock the lockfile. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/842 (hotfix/eslint-pin-4f3a7c9)

maria: can you add a short changelog note so product knows why rule enforcement was relaxed for this rollout?

kevin: done, PR includes changelog entry and a one-line note in release notes draft. Requesting quick review from @olivia.

olivia: reviewing now, will `:thumbsup:` if clean.

deplybot_typo: (bot) — ignoring

deploybot: New commit pushed for pipeline: 9b1d2a7 (hotfix/eslint-pin-4f3a7c9). Re-running lint stage. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/9b1d2a7

olivia: LGTM :thumbsup: — small package.json change only.

deploybot: [lint] PASSED. unit tests running...

sre-oncall: I'll watch server metrics during the canary rollout, ping if we see any latency regression.

deploybot: unit tests PASSED. integration tests PASSED. Deploy to staging: SUCCESS. release/v1.9.3 now points at 9b1d2a7 for staging rollout.

maria: adding final changelog line: "Pin eslint-config-redwood@2.4.0 to avoid new rule enforcement during release". Noting for release notes and internal changelog.

kevin: follow-up: we'll schedule a proper upgrade to v2.5.0 after tidying SDK types; tracking ticket created: ENG-1219.

olivia: thanks everyone, closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
